data.rkef_q2_basis: 100% project basis, nickel metal tonnes (NIC holds 80% indirect interest; attributable approx 22,291t)
data.hnc_mhp_q2_note: Q2 2026 report does NOT disclose HNC production; it discloses HNC sales of 17,824 tonnes of nickel in MHP (100% basis; NIC attributable 10% = 1,782t). Production figure not available.

enc_status: ENC HPAL (NIC 46%) integrated commissioning well advanced: first MHP produced 21 July 2026 from Hengjaya Mine limonite via 22km slurry pipeline; first of three autoclaves feeding ore; first nickel cathode expected mid-August 2026, then LME/SHFE cathode registration; nameplate >72,000t Ni pa. Also announced: 36% interest in CNE HPAL (28,357t Ni pa, via Sampala share swap) and 17.5% in TMI HPAL (38,640t Ni pa, US$169m), both expansions of ENC, commissioning expected mid-2027.
notes: RKEF Q2 Ni production 27,864t down 8% qoq (Q1: 30,264t) due to ANI kiln relining maintenance and higher ore costs (HPM change); ANI/ONI rebound expected Q3, partially offset by HNI major overhaul of one RKEF line from end-June (4 months, ~50% capacity). NPI contract price US$14,522/t Ni up 10% qoq (Q1: US$13,201/t). Group Adjusted EBITDA US$120.5m. HNC production tonnage not disclosed this quarter (sales-only); do not substitute sales as production without flagging.
